Hi NG YING XUAN,
Dennis Lam posted a new assignment in 2019 S1-04 ChangeMakers: Innovation  
and Entrepreneurship (CMIE)  
<https://classroom.google.com/c/MjcyMDU2MzYwOTda>.

Due: Jan 20
Level 1: What is my understanding of collaboration?
Level 2: How do my personal decisions and actions affect others?
Level 3: Why is it important for me to be collaborative? (In what ways does  
learning to collaborate cultivate me as a person?)
Homework for Week 2. Please complete INDIVIDUALLY and submit your answers  
by next Monday morning 8.30am.
